messages:
Maya S: Heads up — Acme team confirmed a 2-week POC starting next Tue. They want dedicated capacity (isolated pool) + autoscale/burst for short demo spikes. Also sent over a security questionnaire we need to answer. Can we provision a small reserved pool and estimate cost for ~2k RPS peaks (15 min bursts)? Need an answer for the sales deck by EOD tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jun Park: Quick q — what model(s) are they planning to run and expected seq lengths? That determines GPU and KV cache sizing.

Maya S: They want to run a mix of instruction-tuned 13B for chat and a 2.7B for embeddings/rerank. Typical input seq ~512 tokens, response avg ~150 tokens. Spiky demo traffic: baseline ~150 RPS, peaks ~2k RPS for ~10-20 minutes.

Ravi K: Ok. For that profile I'd recommend a dedicated pool with a conservative min_replicas to cover baseline and autoscale up with a max_replicas for peak headroom. Suggested starting config:

```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 12
scale_policy: cpu+latency
burst_bucket_capacity: 60000   # token-equivalent credits
burst_replenish_rate: 1000/s
grace_period: 60s
```

This gives short bursts without instant provisioning for every spike. The burst_bucket numeric here is just a rough token-based headroom — we can translate to GPU-hours for pricing.

Jun Park: For the 13B model at seq512 + kv cache, one replica handles roughly 200–300 concurrent short requests depending on batching. With min_replicas=2 baseline ~400–600 concurrent, autoscale to 12 should comfortably hit 2k RPS if batching is effective. We should enable continuous batching + prefix caching.

Elena G: Pricing note — for a 2-week POC we can offer a temporary reserved headroom discount: bill actual usage + a small provisional reserve fee. Two options to present to customer:
- Option A (No commit): Pay-as-you-go, autoscale with burst credits billed by token/GPU-second. Estimated cost for 2-week demo: ~$5k–7k depending on model mix and observed batching.
- Option B (Temp commit): 2-week reserved window (ephemeral) — we hold X GPU capacity and discount by ~20% on that reserved portion; they pay overage if they exceed. Estimated committed portion cost: ~$3.5k + overage.

Add: Need finance approval for discount but sales can present numbers today as indicative.

Samira: Security checklist items from the questionnaire that affect provisioning:
- VPC peering + Private control plane required? (Yes/No)
- KMS integration for model keys & customer data (we support BYOK via KMS/HSM)
- Audit logs retention window (they asked for 12 months)
- Network egress constraints (on-prem or restricted subnet?)

We should confirm whether Acme requires Private deployment (VPC) or just dedicated in our hosted environment. Private adds 2–3 days for networking setup.

Maya S: Acme asked for VPC peering and KMS. They prefer hosted dedicated pool inside their VPC for compliance. They flagged audit logs + SOC2 artifacts as must-have.

Ravi K: That means provisioning flow: create dedicated pool in customer VPC with private control plane, configure IAM roles and KMS integration, then enable autoscaler with burst credits. Lead time ~48–72 hrs for network & KMS coordination depending on customer side. I'll open an infra ticket.

deploy-bot: Ticket #POC-4821 created: "Acme POC - Dedicated VPC pool + autoscale config" assigned to infra-eng. ETA initial provisioning 72h.

Jun Park: For the security answer doc I can draft the relevant sections: network diagram, KMS flow, audit log retention, and which logs we send to their SIEM. Also include fallback policy (if private pool is unavailable we can route to a hosted equivalent with masked data in transit).

Maya S: Perfect. Can you also add explicit limits for burst billing so finance and Acme are aligned? They worry about runaway spikes during demo.

Elena G: We'll add a hard cap on burst spend for the POC and an overage notification threshold at 80% of that cap. If they prefer, we can require manual approval to exceed the cap. I'll include both pricing options and the cap numbers in the deck.

Samira: For the questionnaire I'll note: KMS BYOK supported, VPC peering supported, audit logs export to customer CloudWatch/BigQuery/Splunk, SOC2 artifacts attached. I'll flag that private control plane is required for full compliance and that it affects lead time.

Ravi K: Action items: (1) Provision tentative autoscale config in staging and run a short load test to validate burst_bucket numbers. (2) Draft mapping from burst_bucket -> expected GPU-hours and estimated cost. (3) Coordinate VPC peering scheduling.

Jun Park: I'll run a quick perf run tomorrow AM against a sampled prompt set to validate concurrent throughput and token burn.

Maya S: Thanks all — I'll update the deck with Option A/B and the hard cap, and share it before EOD. Tag me when provisioning ticket is progressing. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Ticket #POC-4821 status updated to "In progress" by Ravi K
